news.title: Observing Civic Engagement Lab receives $1 million AmeriCorps grant to extend research
news.summary_en: O’Neill’s Observing Civic Engagement Lab receives a $1 million AmeriCorps grant to expand research on civic health, community engagement, and local organizations.

news.title: The Forever Threat: How O'Neill School researchers are tackling the PFAS challenge
news.summary_en: So-called "forever chemicals" are a growing issue, and the O'Neill School is hard at work understanding and confronting the crisis.

news.title: Markarova honored with Distinguished Alumni Award
news.summary_en: Oksana Markarova, former Ukrainian ambassador to the U.S. and O’Neill alumna, receives the school’s 2026 Distinguished Alumni Award for public service and leadership.
